# Kernoscope

> 在拿不到硬件性能计数器的受限/多租户 GPU 上，为 CUDA kernel 优化提供「每个数字都标注出处」的性能证据；CLI 与 ncu 兼容，缺依赖时优雅降级并给出下一步。

## 给 agent

- [skills/kernoscope/SKILL.md](skills/kernoscope/SKILL.md): 触发条件、硬规则、闭环脚本（先读这个）
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): 入口与硬规则（≤40 行）
- [COVERAGE.md](COVERAGE.md): 三态覆盖矩阵与能力分层
- [skills/kernoscope/references/verdicts.md](skills/kernoscope/references/verdicts.md): 判词、方向、前提、MDD
- [skills/kernoscope/references/refusal-codes.md](skills/kernoscope/references/refusal-codes.md): 拒绝码 → 怎么办 → 代价

## 人读

- [README.md](README.md): 首屏定位与局限
- [PROVENANCE.md](PROVENANCE.md): 出处体系（exact/measured/estimated/…）
- [CALIBRATION.md](CALIBRATION.md): 本机峰值标定
- [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md): 扩展点
- [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md): 接口层变化

## Optional

- [skills/kernoscope/references/provenance-rules.md](skills/kernoscope/references/provenance-rules.md): 出处纪律短版
- [skills/kernoscope/references/recipes.md](skills/kernoscope/references/recipes.md): 四个闭环配方
- [bench/artifacts/README.md](bench/artifacts/README.md): 真机产物登记表
